Senior Backend Engineer

We are looking for a senior backend engineer to design and operate Python services that
process millions of events per day. You will own APIs built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL data
models, and asynchronous job pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Design reliable, observable services and lead technical design reviews.
- Mentor engineers and communicate trade-offs to product stakeholders.
- Improve performance, cost, and on-call health of production systems.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of Python, strong SQL, experience with distributed systems.
- Clear written and spoken communication.
